scenario_prompt: Write the compliance statement section of an RFP response, stating plainly and separately from any persuasive argument whether the proposed approach meets or does not meet a stated buyer requirement. Context: the buyer's RFP requires a SOC 2 Type II report; the bidder currently holds only a SOC 2 Type I report, and its Type II observation window closes after the RFP's 2026-11-15 submission date. State the compliance answer (met or not met, and why) on its own, apart from any argument for why the bidder should still be selected. Return only the compliance statement text.
text:
RFP answer

**Compliance Statement — SOC 2 Type II Report**

**Not met.** The RFP requires a SOC 2 Type II report. The bidder currently holds a SOC 2 Type I report, not a Type II report. The bidder's SOC 2 Type II observation window closes after 2026-11-15, the RFP's submission date, so a Type II report cannot be produced by that deadline. [PF-2.17 REVIEW (compliance): confirm current SOC 2 Type I status, the Type II observation window end date, and expected Type II report issuance date before this document is sent.]

## Unresolved before this document is sent

| Marker | Rule | What is needed |
|---|---|---|
| [PF-2.17 REVIEW (compliance): confirm current SOC 2 Type I status, the Type II observation window end date, and expected Type II report issuance date before this document is sent.] | PF-2.17 | Human confirmation of current certification status, observation window close date, and projected Type II issuance date — this catalog cannot verify external certification claims. |
